name: Reticulum
summary: Connect to the Reticulum mesh network: chat end to end encrypted with Sideband and MeshChat users over LXMF, watch a live map and traffic charts, find paths, and manage TCP, UDP, rnsd and passphrase interfaces.

screenshots.alt: The Reticulum page with connection, destination, announce, traffic and message tiles above a radial network map of destinations by hop count and a traffic chart

license.terms: Included under the ForkMesh repository licence.

permissions.label: Open TCP and UDP connections to the Reticulum nodes you add, after the ForkMesh firewall allows each one
Send and receive end-to-end encrypted LXMF messages as this desktop's Reticulum identity
Connect to the Reticulum daemon (rnsd) running on this computer
Read a Reticulum config file when you choose to import one
